class_height_m._doc: owner B8 §7 (2026-09-20): canonical rendered class heights. Every preview body is normalised to 1.800 m by its manifest scale_to_metres; TITAN = ATHLETE + 0.3048 m (one real-world foot) at the character ROOT (the whole physique scales, never a neck / leg stretch). GlbCharacter applies height / 1.8 to the body root; the adapter scales the overhead label / LV-HP / bar heights by the same factor; the target proxy is the body itself. Collision in the field rules is a radius (no height term), so nothing changes there.

presentation._doc: PASS 5: every character root renders this far behind the estimated host clock by interpolating between the two bracketing host snapshots (20 Hz ticks, ~60 ms polls) - a constant host speed becomes a constant displayed speed (the exponential filter it replaces left a +/-10 % ripple and ~80 ms of lag). 0 = the old filter.

gait._doc_support: PASS 5 (Spec E): support_drift = how fast the held support point moves back relative to the pelvis as a fraction of travel (0.45 = the owner's hover thrust, the tip drifts with the body; 1.0 = a world-fixed plant, foot slide → 0); support_hold_behind_m = how far behind the hip the hold releases (a plant needs ~0.5 so it lasts the whole support pulse). These three drive ONLY the rollback path (plant = false).
gait._doc_plant: G37 repair (declared pointed contact): plant = the support hold is a WORLD-FIXED point — captured at the support event from the tip's pointed end as written that frame, held by a 3D two-bone IK in the pelvis frame written after the rate filter, released (plant_release_s blend) once the point passes plant_hold_behind_m behind the hip or leaves the leg's reach (plant_reach_frac of thigh + shin + tip_ext). The tip still hovers (owner motion master B: no floor strike); the contact interval = the hold; the measured point = the pointed end. false = the PASS 5 pelvis-frame drifting hold (42.8 cm), kept for A/B.

lean._doc: owner interjection 2026-09-18 §7: ONE centralized lean curve driven continuously by the REAL displayed horizontal speed, normalized by the form's CRUISE speed from the host (play.flight.cruise_mps = canonical band top x air_speed_factor: SPLIT 7.71 m/s, FUSED 20.56 m/s): x = speed / cruise -> degrees of whole-body inclination (piecewise linear). Hover x 0 -> 6 deg; normal forward flight x 1 -> 24 deg; BOOST (`+` in flight, x = boost_factor 1.3) -> 40 deg = the Hinge-inspired forward commitment (the pelvis leads the lean, the arms sweep back and out, the legs / taper trail in line). One curve for both forms because the commitment is about the travel state, not absolute m/s. The camera never reads this.

cruise_mps_fallback._doc: used only for figures whose view carries no host cruise_mps (remote players, rules combatants); derived from the canonical bands x 1.15

lean._previous: before phase D: flight_lean_deg [8, 18] over speed / 8 m/s (rig_profile travel_posture), no flight boost on the host, arm trail 15 deg + 20 deg x fs, leg trail 0.42 x fs with the wrong sign (hip flexion), TAIL2 -0.10 x (0.5 + fs)
lean._arm_note: the sweep-back is capped by the declared shoulder table (rig_profile UPPERARM_x <= 0.70 rad = 40 deg of extension; the soft zone from 0.60 compresses the authored 0.70 to about 0.56 on the bones): the full anatomical sweep, never past it

brake._doc: owner next-pass 2026-09-20 §2 FULL-SPEED FLIGHT BRAKE: when the input releases at ≥ trigger_x of the cruise speed (x = speed / cruise, boost = 1.3) the body absorbs the inertia in one restrained transition — the fused lower body / taper sweeps slightly FORWARD as one connected mass under the torso (pelvis + tail), the torso counter-angles back a little, the head stays level, the arms come forward a touch, shoulders controlled — then settles into the hover pose with no oscillation (critically damped, one envelope: rise → hold → settle ≈ 0.42 s). Low-speed stops (x < trigger_x) never trigger it. Radians / seconds.

hinge._doc: owner JOB A directive 2026-09-19 (supersedes the 2026-09-18 OWNER DECISION note): the RDL / Hinge loads with the femur angled ~45° (0.785 rad forward-down in the world = the hips pushed BACK behind the knees), hips back, shins vertical (knee flexion = femur), a long neutral spine inclined at the hips (torso_rad), eyes forward, the straight arms hanging plumb so the hands reach BELOW the knees, the MAHGIC hurled from the hip drive. Rig signs (measured 2026-09-19): PELVIS + = forward pitch (carries the legs and the taper back), THIGH + = hip EXTENSION (flexion negative), SHIN + = knee flexion, UPPERARM + = arm back. torso 0.70 + femur 0.785 = 1.485 rad of hip flexion: the hip table is relaxed to 90° trunk-to-thigh for this (rig_profile limits_inside_deg.hip_flexion.min 90, THIGH_x −1.57). RELEASE: the hip drive to a tall lockout, the straight arms swing to CHEST height (never overhead), the MAHGIC leaves from the hip drive. Radians.

airborne._doc: in the air there is no floor to load against: a pike (the pelvis pitches, the legs fold forward under the body), then the hip drive snaps the legs back and the torso up - nothing fakes floor support

hinge._fused_note: torso_fused_rad: the FUSED form has no legs to hinge over — its trunk-only hinge keeps the 2026-09-18 incline (0.66) so the hip drive / arm swing timing of the fused release is unchanged; the split RDL uses torso_rad + femur_rad

barrage._doc: owner interjection 2026-09-18 §12: the eight alternating curls are timed to the HOST strike schedule — strikes start after the approach (0.18 s of the 1.15 s recovery = approach_fraction) and span 8 × 0.11 s (strike_fraction of the recovery); the animator derives the striking arm from the cast progress
